title: Ramsey-Theoretic Finiteness in Choiceless Set Theory: The Gower's Collapse and Rainbow and Canonical Separations
summary: We study finiteness classes arising from Ramsey-theoretic principles in set theory without the Axiom of Choice. First, we answer a question of Brot, Cao, and Fernández-Bretón concerning Gowers' $\mathbf{FIN}_k$ theorem. The $\mathbf{FIN}_k$ operation gives rise to a finiteness notion for each $k\geq 1$, but we show that this notion is independent of the value of $k$: the resulting hierarchy collapses, and every level is equivalent to $H$-finiteness, i.e., to Dedekind-finiteness of $[X]^{<ω}$.
